tasks.title: Startup never waits on a leaked models-store lock
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): startup no longer stalls on a leaked models-store lock
tasks.brief: Acceptance, all required: (1) with a fresh lock directory `models-store.json.lock` already present in the agent dir, `ice --help` finishes in under 5 s; (2) after 15 consecutive `ice --help` runs, and after 15 `ice --list-models` runs, no lock directory remains in the agent dir; (3) concurrent writers in one process and across two processes still serialize, and no write is lost (prove with a test). First find which exit path leaks the lock. Then fix the leak at its source, and make sure a read of the models cache never blocks startup for longer than a short bounded wait. Pi-Bolt's models-store.ts, its acquireLockAsync deadline and backoff, and its isPlainRuntimeMetadataCommand are the reference; port what fits. auth.json locking must stay at least as safe as now. Put the regression test at packages/coding-agent/test/models-store-lock.test.ts.

tasks.title: Benchmark harness and TUI screen check
tasks.commit: feat(coding-agent): add the Pi-Bolt port benchmark harness and screen check
tasks.brief: Build bench/pi-bolt/ exactly to the harness contract in the day-1 brief. Use Pi-Bolt's bench/ Python scripts as the design reference; write Node ESM, not Python. The controller validates it: every metric runs once against this checkout and prints samples; an A/A run (this checkout against itself, interleaved, 5 runs each) must show every metric's medians within 10% of each other; the screen check must record and then compare clean twice in a row. Make workloads large enough that CPU metrics are at least 150 ms. Otherwise noise dominates.

tasks.title: Incremental parse of streamed tool-call JSON
tasks.commit: fix(ai): parse streamed tool-call arguments incrementally
tasks.brief: Port Pi-Bolt's streaming tool-call JSON parser: unchanged runs copied in repairJson, the incremental parser, and the switch of every provider caller and packages/agent/src/proxy.ts to it. Callers: mistral-conversations, openai-completions, openai-responses-shared, anthropic-messages, bedrock-converse-stream, ice-messages, agent proxy. The final, authoritative parse at tool-call end must stay a full parse with today's validation. Port the differential test so that the new parser equals the old one on every prefix of its fixtures.

tasks.title: indexOf-based SSE parser for OpenAI and Anthropic streams
tasks.commit: fix(ai): read OpenAI and Anthropic streams with an indexOf-based SSE parser
tasks.brief: Port Pi-Bolt's SSE parser and its use in the OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic stream paths. Only where ICE's code path matches: ICE routes most traffic through openai-completions to the local Omni Router, so that path matters most. Port the differential tests: same events as the SDK parser for every chunking of the fixtures, including CRLF, comments, multi-line data and a final event without a trailing newline.

tasks.title: Edit previews and patches diff only changed lines
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): edit previews and patches diff only the changed lines
tasks.brief: Port the edit-diff fast path together with the reference implementation used as the oracle in its tests. The diff output must stay byte-identical to the current output on every fixture.

tasks.title: Truncation cuts once; tool output kept once
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): truncate tool output in one step and keep it once
tasks.brief: Port both commits. Truncated text, the truncation notice and the persisted session entries must stay identical. If ICE's observability or session history reads details.truncation, keep that working.

tasks.title: Session projection cached between calls
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): keep the session projection between calls
tasks.brief: Port the projection cache. It must invalidate on every mutation path in ICE's SessionManager. ICE has more of them than Pi: branching, compaction, subagent records, extension entries and observability entries. Enumerate them in the test.

tasks.title: Skip extension dispatch and conversation clone when unused
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): skip extension events nobody listens to
tasks.brief: Port the emit fast path and the clone skip. ICE ships built-in extensions (safe-verify, subagents V2, MCP bridge, Cognee, observability) that listen to many events. Verify the fast path triggers only when no handler, including built-ins, is registered for the event. Never skip a clone that a listener could observe being mutated.

tasks.title: Load heavy modules on first use
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): load the image decoder, zlib, net, worker_threads and undici on first use
tasks.brief: Port the lazy loading of the image decoder, zlib, node:net, worker_threads and undici, including skipping the undici dispatcher on Bun. Use Pi-Bolt's *.lazy.ts pattern; AGENTS.md otherwise forbids dynamic import. Skip the Herdr item if ICE has no Herdr extension. Each lazy module needs a test proving it is not loaded at startup and still works on first use.

tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): one model refresh at start and no blocking probes before the first frame
tasks.brief: Port three things: the startup dedupe of the models refresh and the sanitize-unicode well-formed skip; registering highlight.js grammars on first use; and moving the tmux hyperlink probe off the start path. Highlighted output must be identical once a grammar is loaded.

tasks.title: Key IDs and key input parsed once per key press
tasks.commit: fix(tui): parse key IDs and key input once per key press
tasks.brief: Port the key parse cache. Every keybinding must resolve exactly as before, including Kitty, modifyOtherKeys and legacy sequences.

tasks.title: Editor keeps wrapped chunks of unchanged lines
tasks.commit: fix(tui): editor keeps the wrapped chunks of unchanged lines
tasks.brief: Port the editor wrap cache. Invalidate on line text, width and any ICE-specific prompt decoration.

tasks.title: Containers and boxes keep their lines between frames
tasks.commit: fix(tui): containers keep their lines between frames
tasks.brief: Port the Container/Box/Text/Spacer/MouseRegion/layout memo. Any child invalidate() or content change must dirty its ancestors.

tasks.title: Regular mode finishes only the lines that changed
tasks.commit: fix(tui): regular mode finishes only the lines that changed
tasks.brief: Port main-screen line reuse: skip the line resets and Kitty image scan for lines that did not change.

tasks.title: Transcript rows keep their lines when unchanged
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): transcript rows keep their lines and unchanged content
tasks.brief: Port renderShared for the assistant message, tool execution, user message and visual truncate, plus the tool-execution updateArgs identity guard. The ICE assistant message also renders appearance-dependent and OSC133 output; key the memo on all of it.

tasks.title: Streaming Markdown lexed and rendered from its last blocks
tasks.commit: fix(tui): stream Markdown from its last blocks instead of re-lexing the whole message
tasks.brief: Port incremental suffix lexing, settled-block reuse, the rendered-block cache shared across components, and the full re-lex once a message is finished. Include the later fix commits, not only the first. Rendering must equal a full lex for every prefix of the test fixtures. ICE's Marked version, custom themes and transforms decide what is safe to reuse; fall back to a full lex whenever unsure.

tasks.title: Redraw only entries that may use on-demand grammars
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): redraw only what may use grammars loaded on demand
tasks.brief: Port the scoped redraw when a grammar finishes loading. Depends on D2-08; if D2-08 did not pass, report that and stop.

tasks.title: Idle-time garbage collection on Bun
tasks.commit: fix(coding-agent): collect garbage when idle after a run on Bun
tasks.brief: Port idle GC: Bun only, after 500 ms idle and 32 MB of heap growth, never during a run. On Node it must be a no-op.

tasks.title: Bun binary built from a bundle with bytecode
tasks.commit: feat(coding-agent): build the Bun binary from a bundle with bytecode
tasks.brief: Make `npm run build:binary` in packages/coding-agent produce dist/ice with `--bytecode`. Bundle with esbuild first if Bun needs it, as Pi-Bolt does; only if esbuild is already in node_modules, because no new dependencies are allowed. Keep the worker entry and the copied assets. scripts/build-binaries.sh must get the same flag. Report `dist/ice --version` and `--help` wall time for 5 runs before and after. The controller only checks that the binary builds and passes smoke runs, not the timing.
